THE CINDER TABLE

Maren, Ossic, and Ines sit down to four rounds of cards. Each seat sees only its own hand until a void shows on the table.

Loading the engine...

Private hands

Each seat's hand sits at the top of the table board, filtered from Knows(seat, card) so no player can consider a card from another seat or replay one already spent. Click any player on stage to list their remaining cards.

Public voids

In round 2, Maren leads Cinder 1. Having no cinder, Ossic discards Reed 1 and exposes Void(Ossic, Cinder); that public fact raises Maren's score for Cinder 2 from 4 to 6 so she leads cinder again in round 3.

Inspect the table

Watch the four rounds fill on the center felt board, click TallyBoard or Tokens, or scrub any tick on the timeline bar at the top. Press Space to pause and step round by round with Next round or S.

Keys

  • S: play one card (step one tick)
  • Space: pause / resume automatic play
  • R: rewind to the deal and replay identically
  • I: state inspector (inspect Knows, Played, and Void facts)
Runs entirely in your browser on the BeSpoke Engine, a simulation engine for systemic and narrative games. The whole game is in this one file; nothing is downloaded or tracked.
